rules.citation: Part II, Title I, Chapter 186, Section 12
rules.title: Notice to determine estate at will
rules.requirement: Either party may terminate an estate at will with written notice: generally three months, or if rent is payable more frequently than every three months, the payment interval or 30 days, whichever is longer. For nonpayment by a tenant at will, a landlord may terminate with 14 days’ written notice to quit, but a tenant who has not received a similar notice in the prior 12 months can prevent termination by paying all rent due within 10 days after receiving the notice.
rules.key_value: 3 months' notice; or payment interval/30 days, whichever is longer; 14-day nonpayment notice with 10-day cure

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to estates at will and tenants at will.
coverage.summary: Covers Massachusetts estates at will, including tenants at will facing termination for nonpayment of rent.
